summary: The comment opposes the proposal to sunset the E-Rate program, emphasizing the program's importance for providing internet access to schools and ensuring educational access for students. The comment argues that cutting the program will further damage education, particularly in rural areas.

claims.requested_action: continue E-Rate funding at full level
claims.argument: Cutting E-Rate will further damage education, especially in rural schools
claims.evidence_quote: Without that funding, education will suffer, and we will fall behind the rest of the world.
